name: Scenting Fear
summary: Once per battle round, in your Shooting phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly War Dog unit: it gets +6" detection range.

name: Malefic Surge
summary: In your Command phase, a Chaos Knights unit can test Leadership (or take D3 mortal wounds) to become Empowered until your next Command phase, then once use: +3" Move, Lethal Hits, Sustained Hits 1, a 5+ invuln save, or Feel No Pain 6+.

name: Tyrannical Court
summary: Chaos Knights Character models get +2 Objective Control. Once per battle round, while your Warlord is on the battlefield, use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.

name: Paragons of Terror
summary: At the first battle round, after selecting your army's Dread abilities, add one further Dread ability of your choice (not randomly selected).
